claims.evidence: The witness report describes the color and logos but does not detail the physical condition, scratches, or cleanliness of the vents.
The witness confirmed the console is gold-colored, which matches the Limited Edition Gold PS4 Slim.
The witness explicitly listed controllers as 'not shown'.
The witness explicitly listed HDMI and power cables as 'not shown'.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting from a cold start to the PlayStation home screen.

risks.risk: The internal storage might be the base 500GB rather than 1TB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty and unable to read or eject games.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and then ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The 'follow come' controller might be a third-party replica or have 'analog drift'.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the controller's rear sticker and a video of it navigating the menu.

risks.risk: The console could be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the main menu.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing storage and software version.
Photos of the included controller (front and back) and cables.
Video of a disc being inserted and loaded.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity as a PS4 Slim. It will be priced at the worst-case value (non-functional, no accessories) until proof of working condition and inclusions is provided.
